text: Sorry if I'm being daft now but my little one is 3 and she's burning up, 40 on the thermometer. She has these tiny dark spots coming up. They're hard enough to see on her because her skin is dark, so I went looking on the palms of her hands and soles of her feet and inside her mouth where it's paler, and they're there too, little reddy-purple dots. I pressed a glass on her hand like you'd see on the telly and they didn't go away at all, still there through the glass. Grand otherwise I suppose but I just wanted to check with someone
